title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Omastar Pokemon 151 139/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Omastar Pokémon card is a must-have for any serious collector. With its stunning holo finish and beautiful illustration, this card is sure to be the centerpiece of your collection. Manufactured by Nintendo in Japan and part of the Pokémon 151 set, this card is a true gem.

Featuring Omastar, a powerful Water-type Pokémon, this Stage 2 card is a valuable addition to any deck. Its card number is 139/165 and it is a Holo Rare. Perfect for fans of all ages, this card is a great way to show your love for the Pokémon TCG. Don't miss your chance to own this incredible card!
